TRADEMARK LICENSE AGREEMENT

This Trademark License Agreement (this "Agreement") is made as of August 3, 2026 between Vanterra Coffee Roasters, Inc., a Washington corporation with offices at 1900 Salmon Bay Way, Seattle, Washington 98107 ("Licensor"), and Northbrook Provisions, LLC, an Illinois limited liability company with offices at 44 Ridgeline Court, Evanston, Illinois 60201 ("Licensee").

RECITALS

A. Licensor owns the trademarks and service marks listed on Schedule A, including U.S. Registration No. 5,882,014 for VANTERRA and U.S. Registration No. 6,101,773 for the Vanterra bird design (collectively, the "Licensed Marks"), together with the goodwill of the business symbolized by them.

B. Licensee wishes to use the Licensed Marks on and in connection with ready-to-drink bottled coffee beverages sold through grocery and convenience retail channels in the United States.

AGREEMENT

1. LICENSE GRANT

1.1 Grant. Licensor grants Licensee a non-exclusive, non-transferable, royalty-bearing license to use the Licensed Marks solely on and in connection with ready-to-drink bottled coffee beverages (the "Licensed Products") in the United States (the "Territory") and solely through grocery, convenience, and club retail channels of trade (the "Channels"). Use outside the Licensed Products, the Territory, or the Channels is outside the field of use of this license.

1.2 Reservation. Licensor reserves all rights not expressly granted. No license is granted under any patent, copyright, or trade secret of Licensor except as necessary to use the Licensed Marks as this Agreement permits. Licensee acquires no ownership interest in the Licensed Marks.

1.3 Sublicensing. Licensee may not sublicense the Licensed Marks. Licensee may engage a contract manufacturer to apply the Licensed Marks to Licensed Products, provided the manufacturer is approved in writing by Licensor and is bound in writing to the quality-control obligations of Section 3.

2. OWNERSHIP AND GOODWILL

2.1 Ownership. Licensor is and remains the sole and exclusive owner of the Licensed Marks. Licensee shall not contest, challenge, or assist any third party in contesting the validity of the Licensed Marks or Licensor's ownership of them, whether during the Term or after it.

2.2 Goodwill. All use of the Licensed Marks by Licensee, and all goodwill arising from that use, inures solely to the benefit of Licensor. Licensee shall not acquire any right in the Licensed Marks by reason of its use.

2.3 Registration. Licensee shall not apply to register the Licensed Marks, any mark confusingly similar to them, or any domain name or social-media handle incorporating them, anywhere in the world. At Licensor's request and expense, Licensee shall execute documents reasonably necessary to record this license or to confirm Licensor's ownership.

3. QUALITY CONTROL

3.1 Standards. Licensee shall manufacture, package, market, and sell the Licensed Products in accordance with the quality standards and specifications set out in Schedule B, and in compliance with all applicable law, including the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act and applicable state food-safety requirements.

3.2 Pre-Production Approval. Before first commercial use, and before any material change, Licensee shall submit to Licensor samples of each Licensed Product and of all packaging, labels, point-of-sale material, and advertising bearing the Licensed Marks. Licensor shall approve or reject each submission within fifteen (15) business days; a submission not rejected within that period is deemed approved. Licensee shall not use any material Licensor has rejected.

3.3 Continuing Samples. At Licensor's request, and no more than twice in any calendar year, Licensee shall furnish six (6) production samples of each Licensed Product at no charge.

3.4 Inspection. Licensor or its representative may inspect any facility where Licensed Products are manufactured, packaged, or stored, during normal business hours and on five (5) business days' notice, to verify compliance with the quality standards.

3.5 Cure of Quality Failures. If Licensor notifies Licensee that a Licensed Product fails to meet the quality standards, Licensee shall cure the failure within thirty (30) days and shall not ship non-conforming Licensed Products bearing the Licensed Marks after that period.

4. PROPER USE OF THE MARKS

4.1 Form of Use. Licensee shall use the Licensed Marks only in the form and with the proportions shown in Schedule A, shall use each mark as an adjective modifying the generic name of the product ("VANTERRA cold brew coffee"), and shall not pluralize, abbreviate, hyphenate, translate, or use a mark as a noun or verb.

4.2 Notices. Licensee shall display the ® symbol adjacent to each federally registered Licensed Mark on packaging and advertising, and shall include the legend "VANTERRA is a registered trademark of Vanterra Coffee Roasters, Inc., used under license."

4.3 No Composite Marks. Licensee shall not combine any Licensed Mark with any other trademark, trade name, or design, or use any Licensed Mark as part of Licensee's corporate or trade name.

5. ROYALTIES AND REPORTING

5.1 Royalty. Licensee shall pay Licensor a royalty of five percent (5%) of Net Sales of Licensed Products, subject to an annual minimum royalty of $150,000.

5.2 Payment and Reports. Licensee shall deliver a royalty report and pay the royalty due within thirty (30) days after the end of each calendar quarter. Each report shall state gross sales, deductions, Net Sales, and the royalty computation by product.

5.3 Records and Audit. Licensee shall keep complete records of sales of Licensed Products for three (3) years and shall permit Licensor's auditor to examine them once in any twelve (12) month period. If an audit shows an underpayment of more than five percent (5%) for the period audited, Licensee shall pay the cost of the audit.

6. INFRINGEMENT

6.1 Notice. Each party shall promptly notify the other of any infringement, dilution, or unauthorized use of the Licensed Marks that comes to its attention, and of any claim that use of the Licensed Marks infringes a third party's rights.

6.2 Control. Licensor has the sole right, but not the obligation, to bring or settle any action concerning the Licensed Marks. Licensee shall cooperate at Licensor's expense and shall not bring any such action without Licensor's written consent.

7. REPRESENTATIONS AND INDEMNITY

7.1 Licensor. Licensor represents that it owns the Licensed Marks and has the right to grant this license.

7.2 Licensee Indemnity. Licensee shall indemnify, defend, and hold harmless Licensor and its officers, directors, and employees against any claim arising out of the manufacture, sale, or use of a Licensed Product, or out of Licensee's breach of this Agreement, other than a claim that the Licensed Marks themselves infringe a third party's rights. Licensor shall give prompt notice of any such claim, and Licensee shall control the defense and shall not settle a claim imposing a non-monetary obligation on Licensor without Licensor's consent.

7.3 Insurance. Licensee shall maintain commercial general liability insurance, including product liability coverage, of at least $5,000,000 per occurrence, naming Licensor as an additional insured, and shall deliver a certificate of insurance on request.

7.4 Limitation. Except for Licensee's indemnity obligations and any breach of Section 2, neither party's aggregate liability under this Agreement shall exceed the royalties paid or payable in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim.

8. TERM AND TERMINATION

8.1 Term. This Agreement begins on the Effective Date and continues for five (5) years (the "Term"), renewing for successive one-year terms unless either party gives written notice of non-renewal at least ninety (90) days before the end of the then-current term.

8.2 Termination for Cause. Either party may terminate this Agreement if the other materially breaches it and fails to cure within thirty (30) days after written notice. Licensor may terminate immediately if Licensee challenges the validity of a Licensed Mark, uses a Licensed Mark outside the field of use, or fails to cure a quality failure under Section 3.5.

8.3 Effect of Termination. On expiration or termination, Licensee shall immediately cease all use of the Licensed Marks, except that Licensee may sell off existing inventory of conforming Licensed Products for ninety (90) days, subject to the quality standards and to the royalty obligation. Licensee shall destroy or deliver to Licensor all packaging, labels, and advertising bearing the Licensed Marks that it does not use in the sell-off, and shall certify that it has done so. Sections 2, 5.3, 7 and 9 survive.

9. GENERAL

9.1 Governing Law; Venue. This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Washington, without regard to its conflict of laws principles. Any action arising out of this Agreement shall be brought in the state or federal courts located in King County, Washington.

9.2 Assignment. Licensee may not assign this Agreement or delegate any obligation under it, by operation of law or otherwise, without Licensor's prior written consent, and any attempted assignment without that consent is void. Licensor may assign this Agreement together with the Licensed Marks.

9.3 Notices. All notices shall be in writing and delivered by hand, by nationally recognized overnight courier, or by electronic mail with confirmation of receipt, to the addresses first stated above.

9.4 Entire Agreement; Amendment. This Agreement, with its schedules, is the entire agreement between the parties and may be amended only in a writing signed by both.

9.5 Counterparts. This Agreement may be executed in counterparts, including by electronic signature.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties have executed this Agreement as of the date first written above.
